parties.respondent: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and Others

summary: Audit failure in detecting circuitous transactions; Director (Discipline) found no prima facie misconduct; Board of Discipline overruled Director's opinion under Rule 9(3)(b) of CA Rules 2007; validity of rule challenged as ultra vires Section 21A(4) of Chartered Accountants Act; interpretation of statutory roles of Director vs Board; Board's authority to refer matter to Disciplinary Committee upheld; challenge to rule-making power rejected.
legal_provisions_cited: Chartered Accountants Act, 1949 s.21; s.21A(4); s.21B
Chartered Accountants (Procedure of Investigation of Professional and Other Misconduct and Conduct of Cases) Rules, 2007 r.9(3)(b)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding Rule 9(3)(b) affirmed.
